inheritance.actor: MM01 common 12000 full training checkpoint, including optimizer; resolve exact path from original ledger
inheritance.wm: MM01 2800-update perceptual dynamics; frozen p/o/v normalization restored
inheritance.bc_sources: original 17 training episodes/35026 eligible labels; no validation or test

environment.robot: free M1 + Piper H + official gripper

teacher.implementation_required: stateful P6CorrectionTeacher extracted from actual P6 control loop
teacher.init: frame0 fixed arm home, jaw home and leg_rest; preserve phase, integral, IK, last command and timing
teacher.query_validity: per-time/per-channel finite, mapped range and controller/IK validity; query validity is not a physical success claim

schema_required.fork_history: actual prefix, previous action, elapsed sensor time and exposure phase; no fake reset

affine_pilot.new_parameter_gradient_clip: separate group; report norms and updates
affine_pilot.selection: adaptive only if more complete successes, or equal successes with more total ordered events and no increase in limit/self-collision first failures; otherwise fixed
affine_pilot.serialization: affine_mode stored in training/deployment packages; loader creates buffer or Parameter before loading; old AdamW mapped by parameter name, new group separate; legacy schema readable

main.shared_data: union of both branches; identical BC membership and row order
main.sampling: balance scene/task/source, then episode/row; log missing strata and explicit fallback
main.normalization: restore/fix original actor and WM units; report saturation coverage
main.mix_selection: whole 23-channel executor; paired deterministic block RNG by task; no action averaging or 200ms action hold
main.extend_if: otherwise, compare rounds3/4 with the best rounds1/2 result within each matching branch/scene/side/goal: a new complete success, or next ordered event reached in at least two distinct side/goal combinations; each item must improve in its own matched case; no cross-checkpoint bilateral-success claim
main.otherwise: close after round4; no isolated WM error or millimetric change gate
main.encoder_requires_grad_toggle: explicit True at each first-2048 phase and False at paired-512 phase; optimizer includes named encoder parameters
main.extend_decision_source: only fixed round-end pure-student development cases; no mixed collection or blind results
main.stop_if_bilateral_success: one branch at its frozen round4 terminal checkpoint has at least one full success on each side across fixed development cases

recovery_targets.training_anchor_source: current student-visited train states and mixed states with prior actual student action
recovery_targets.validation_source: va_pose only, never used for fitting
recovery_targets.incomplete_branch: keep legal BC/WM prefixes; never pad a fake H32 target
recovery_targets.sampling: unique anchors with available stage coverage; repeats and empty strata disclosed

world_model.replay: only actual actions and physical successors in shared training data
world_model.bridge_binding: after current model branch's 2048 BC steps; bind new frozen encoder and WM units
world_model.validation: teacher-action open-loop separate from student imagined closed-loop; same-exposure vision vs held image

h32.start_sampler: independent real teacher-recovery anchor sampler, not BC batch prefix

loss.state_terms_normalization: discounted sum divided by valid discounted horizon sum

h32.numerical_check: one frozen directional derivative plus first-batch group losses/gradients; not a performance gate
h32.zero_valid_H32_anchors: do not fake updates; continue valid BC/WM and report H32 unexecuted

evaluation.primary_checkpoint: fixed terminal round4 or round6; no blind best-node selection
evaluation.first_full_video: immediate from any pure student frame0 complete original-judge episode; label training/development/formal

ratio_metrics.angle_progress: (actual_angle-initial_angle)/(command_angle-initial_angle), report absolute deg and no clipping
ratio_metrics.joint_error: RMSE_rad / allowed_joint_range_rad with actual matching definition
ratio_metrics.success_gain: percentage-point difference; no fold gain over zero
ratio_metrics.paper_090_088: not the score denominator for this new task

evaluation.success_repeat_scope: two main branches only; initial/pilot pure successes can be videoed but do not automatically add repeat cases
evaluation.terminal_reload_dedup: count once if the exact same actual rollout is also a registered first-success repeat; otherwise separate from 40 formal and 16 repeat maximum

execution.publish: normal fast-forward main update and fixed-commit readback
